title: tridens elongatus
intro: Tridens elongatus, commonly known as Bristle Grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to provide various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and promoting digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Bristle Grass are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which are said to help soothe digestive issues and alleviate symptoms of arthritis. The bioactive constituents of Bristle Grass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
